bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
old="sha256:999a9fa61cb476510c60df5afeca6509a077a1c9c5aa820317dd5f5e7660b8c8"
candidate="sha256:0b63fb73669dc7d7ccf1cf9b3012f596710e9faa8eedc5e354151ec3dfb0025d"
compose="/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/.worktrees/profile-live-20261114/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test -f "$compose"
test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-candidate)" = "$candidate"
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old"
test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$old"
docker compose --project-name deploy -f "$compose" config -q >/dev/null
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-rollback
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-candidate gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
rollback(){
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pr47-rollback gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose --project-name deploy -f "$compose" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
if ! docker compose --project-name deploy -f "$compose" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null; then
 rollback; exit 82
fi
sleep 5
current="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || true)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || true)"
if test "$current" != "$candidate" || test "$running" != "true"; then
 rollback; exit 83
fi
printf 'PR47_GAYBBS_DEPLOY=PASS\nSOURCE_HEAD=0cfc593e1883c2e0a27748d18d8868118354eac1\nIMAGE_ID=%s\nSERVICE=deploy-gaybbs-1\nRUNNING=true\nROLLBACK_IMAGE_RETAINED=YES\n' "$current" | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
